Paragraph: "Those peacocks that are surorounded by their peahens and convulsed in love are intensifying longing in me, who am already muffled in love-longing...
Situation/Problem_Faced: Seeing peacocks surrounded by peahens in love amplifies Rama's own love-longing.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Rama acknowledges how seeing love expressed around him intensifies his own feelings of deprivation.
Outcome/Resolution: He expresses his compounded feeling of love-sickness.

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Manmadha-Vardhana (Intensification of love longing by seeing others in union)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Seeing natural romantic union stirs deeper spiritual longing for union with the supreme divine consort.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Observing intimate partnerships in one's immediate environment exacerbates feelings of personal loneliness and romantic deprivation.
